title: Valuation Guideline: Lost Income and Blocked Calendar Nights under HostCover
content:
Lost income on a **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** income-loss claim is valued by the lost-nights method. The lost-nights method values the lost income from the claim's verified loss and the nights the listing's calendar holds blocked for the booking the host cancelled (the most recent calendar block placed on the listing for a host cancellation, counted from its first blocked night to the day after its last). On a level that does not cover lost income nothing is payable. On a covering level, when the blocked nights exceed the level's most cancelled nights paid on one income-loss claim, the verified loss is multiplied by that number of nights and divided by the blocked nights; otherwise the verified loss is taken whole. The value so set is the lost income being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

## The calendar block

The calendar blocks are those Listings records against the listing the HostCover plan covers. The one read is the most recent block placed for a host cancellation. Its nights are counted from the first blocked night to the day after the last blocked night: a block from 9 July with the day after its last night on 19 July holds 10 nights.

## Levels

| HostCover level | Lost income covered | Most cancelled nights paid on one income-loss claim |
|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | No | 0 |
| HostCover Standard | No | 0 |
| HostCover Plus | Yes | 7 |
| HostCover Premier | Yes | 14 |
| HostCover Elite | Yes | 30 |
| HostCover Estate | Yes | 60 |

## Valuation by case (hypothetical claims, verified loss 2000.00)

| Level | Blocked nights | Valuation | Lost income valued at |
|---|---|---|---|
| HostCover Standard | any | level does not cover lost income | nothing payable |
| HostCover Plus | 10 | 10 exceeds 7: 2000.00 multiplied by 7 and divided by 10 | 1400.00 |
| HostCover Plus | 7 | 7 does not exceed 7: taken whole | 2000.00 |
| HostCover Premier | 10 | 10 does not exceed 14: taken whole | 2000.00 |
